This E log book also reflects my patient-centred online learning portfolio and your valuable comments on comment box is welcome.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EI've been given this case to solve in an attempt to understand the topic of \"patient clinical data analysis\" to develop my competency in reading and comprehending clinical data including history, clinical findings, investigations and come up with a diagnosis and treatment plan.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ECHIEF COMPLAINTS:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EC\/O SHORTNESS OF BREATH SINCE TODAY MORNING 3AM.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic 5 years back.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThen he developed\u0026nbsp; right sided hemiplegia, for which he took medication and was also diagnosed to have type 2 diabetes mellitus and hypertension.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAfter 3 years he was operated for Hernia.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAfter 1 year, he had severe back pain, went to hospital, xray KUB was done and diagnosed to have renal calculi.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E2 months back\u0026nbsp; he developed shortness of breath, came to our hospital and was diagnosed with AKI on CKD with emphysematous pyelonephritis underwent 3 sessions of hemodialysis.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EToday morning\u0026nbsp; he developed shortness of breath,which was insidious in onset, gradually progressive.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EOrthopnea+\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb style=\"letter-spacing: 0.2px;\"\u003EHISTORY OF PAST ILLNESS\u003C\/b\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb style=\"letter-spacing: 0.2px;\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EH\/o DM , HYPERTENSION SINCE 5 YEARS\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\n\u003Cp dir=\"ltr\"\u003ENo history of\u0026nbsp; Today (3\/11\/22) serum creatinine is 1.4, patient is discharged in hemodynamically stable condition.\u003Cbr style=\"letter-spacing: 0.2px;\"\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cp dir=\"ltr\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E"},"link":[{"rel":"replies","type":"application/atom+xml","href":"https:\/\/aishwaryagannoji35.blogspot.com\/feeds\/3387985375912576846\/comments\/default","title":"Post Comments"},{"rel":"replies","type":"text/html","href":"https:\/\/aishwaryagannoji35.blogspot.com\/2022\/11\/35-year-old-male-with-shortness-of.html#comment-form","title":"0 Comments"},{"rel":"edit","type":"application/atom+xml","href":"https:\/\/www.blogger.com\/feeds\/270702665757627107\/posts\/default\/3387985375912576846"},{"rel":"self","type":"application/atom+xml","href":"https:\/\/www.blogger.com\/feeds\/270702665757627107\/posts\/default\/3387985375912576846"},{"rel":"alternate","type":"text/html","href":"https:\/\/aishwaryagannoji35.blogspot.com\/2022\/11\/35-year-old-male-with-shortness-of.html","title":"35 Year old male with shortness of breath."}],"author":[{"name":{"$t":"Aishwarya Gannoji"},"uri":{"$t":"http:\/\/www.blogger.com\/profile\/10201090273801977164"},"email":{"$t":"noreply@blogger.com"},"gd$image":{"rel":"http://schemas.google.com/g/2005#thumbnail","width":"32","height":"31","src":"\/\/blogger.googleusercontent.com\/img\/b\/R29vZ2xl\/AVvXsEhwQoUJh7dFDDVzD70Hk0-jfr-mI6e9ZtEAkqN5XHMStfIvgTO7O1WmTpYo8bdSXYPQW_H2tcBtTgkLoDZEms5K7TshpAuLb5oBHvwjw2LAlg0jdleTHlSQimhEwFjEBA\/s118\/IMG_20211002_215343.jpg"}}],"media$thumbnail":{"xmlns$media":"http://search.yahoo.com/mrss/","url":"https:\/\/blogger.googleusercontent.com\/img\/b\/R29vZ2xl\/AVvXsEiq7Aju3q5Uw4sh3qtvXJMJXgWVkSFiw6VEJETtr6UFaLSjFSrH6ooKYqo83w_K7dihRZevlSFfaXG5vB858WfnJl5jhBt_5-Lu3870TILyHmJ4BfnDZJQnV5ZujTJORTfUY_uFMJ83i-o\/s72-c\/1667362283479009-0.png","height":"72","width":"72"},"thr$total":{"$t":"0"}}]}}
